an3.92:1.3: Idha bhikkhave kassako gahapati sīghasīghaṃ khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karoti sumatikataṃ
an3.92:1.4: sīghasīghaṃ khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karitvā sumatikataṃ sīghasīgham pi bījāni patiṭṭhāpeti,
an3.92:1.5: sīghasīghaṃ bījāni patiṭṭhāpetvā sīghasīghaṃ udakaṃ abhineti pi apaneti pi.
an3.92:1.6: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi kassakassa gahapatissa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:1.7: Tassa kho taṃ bhikkhave kassakassa gahapatissa n' atthi sā iddhi vā ānubhāvo vā
an3.92:1.8: ajj' eva me dhaññāni jāyantu sv' eva gabbhiniyo hontu uttarass' eva paccantū ti.
an3.92:1.9: Atha kho bhikkhave hoti so samayo yaṃ tassa kassakassa gahapatissa tāni dhaññāni utupariṇāmini jāyanti pi gabbhinī pi honti paccanti pi. 2. Evam
an3.92:2.1: eva kho bhikkhave tīṇ' imāni bhikkhussa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:2.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi bhikkhussa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:2.5: Tassa kho taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno n' atthi sā iddhi vā ānubhāvo vā,
an3.92:2.6: ajj' eva me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatu sve vā uttarass' evā ti.
an3.92:2.7: Atha kho bhikkhave hoti so samayo yaṃ tassa bhikkhuno adhisīlam pi sikkhato adhicittam pi sikkhato adhipaññam pi sikkhato anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an3.92:3.2: tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne . . . pe . . . tibbo no chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne ti. Evaṃ hi
